answer: Producing 65 answers an epoch therefore costs 46 real forward passes, and the mesa record lets any auditor recompute the check. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as an ember header. Replaying a stored transcript fails as the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a ripple spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
